paragraphs.text: Malkean Feorr was an Argivian Archaeologist on Dominaria who frequented Grover ’s tavern.

He told Loot , Kyyrao , and "Nameless" about the history of the Peregrinator Complex . Loot invited Malkean to come along on the adventure, but he declined. An expedition was due back soon, and the scholars didn't want to miss the opportunity to examine the artifacts they were sure to bring back.
After Sopti Borth 's murder, Malkean suspected Loot of being N'ciczli , a legendary war-priest from the past.
